## ✨ Added

- `CONFIG_DIR` keeps the database apart from the uploads: the SQLite metadata database can live on its own volume, away from the bulk files. Point `DATA_DIR` (`/data`) at array storage for the files and `CONFIG_DIR` (`/config`) at a fast SSD or appdata volume for the small database. The Unraid template shows both as separate mappings (Data Directory and Config Directory).
- Custom branding for self-hosters: set `APP_NAME` (wordmark and tab title), `APP_LOGO` (a logo image URL that replaces the feather) and `ACCENT_COLOR` (a hex value for the buttons, the progress ring and other accents). Each one falls back to the featherdrop default when unset.
- Download limit, or burn after download: cap how many times a share can be downloaded. The file is deleted the moment the limit is reached. The count is atomic, so the limit can never be exceeded, and a bogus request can't burn the file.
- Inline image and PDF preview on the download page, shown only for unlimited, password-less shares. It never gets around a download limit and never counts as a download.
- Save the QR code as a PNG: download the share QR as a crisp image for printing or pasting into a chat.
- Link previews (Open Graph and Twitter cards): a shared link shows a branded preview card. The card is generic on purpose and never gives away the file's name.

## 🎨 Design

- New logo: a gold medallion with the feather carved out as negative space. The favicon, the README banner and the Unraid template icon match it. A self-hoster's `APP_LOGO` still overrides it.
- Living background: the gold and violet aurora drifts slowly, and holds still for visitors who prefer reduced motion.
- Centered brand: the logo and wordmark in the header are centered, with the light/dark and language controls floating top right, so the start screen reads more evenly (`app/page.tsx`).
- The result and download windows react to the pointer: their gold hairline border lights up with a soft glow on hover, just like the drop zone (`app/globals.css`).
- Simpler wording: the result window heading just says "Your link is ready" (`lib/i18n/locales/en.ts`, `de.ts`).
- Init-log banner: the banner printed at container startup reads "Encrypted at rest, auto-deleted when the link expires", in line with the UI subtitle. The stray separator above the ASCII banner is gone, and there is some breathing room between the banner and the title block (`docker-entrypoint.sh`, `print-banner.sh`).

## ⚡ Improved

- Backward compatible, with no migration needed: existing shares, links and volumes keep working. `CONFIG_DIR` defaults to `DATA_DIR`, so single-volume installs carry on unchanged and the database stays in `/data` until you set `CONFIG_DIR`.
- Moving an existing install to two volumes? Move your current `db.sqlite` from the data volume into the new config volume before you start the container, or the app creates a fresh, empty database in `/config`.
- Hardened inline preview: the server only previews inert types (PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP and PDF) and sends them with `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`, so an uploaded HTML or SVG file can never run script on the app's origin. Everything else downloads as an attachment.

## 🌐 Translations

- The download-limit and "Save QR code" strings read correctly in all 26 languages, with no English fallbacks for non-English plurals.
